title: Evals: config/model change handoff & signal consolidator for Console alerts
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Build a consolidation layer and handoff metadata model so the Evals system can surface high-confidence quality regressions tied to configuration or model changes into the Console alerting pipeline (Slack + PagerDuty) with meaningful deduplication and contextual links. This ticket scopes the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout strategy for a signal consolidator that reduces noisy alerts during frequent config/model rollouts and provides operators with actionable context (diffs, sample failing inputs, rollout IDs, correlated traffic spikes).
background: The Evals change detector produces many signals when evaluation thresholds move and when model/config rollouts occur. Teams complain about duplicate Slack threads and repeated PagerDuty triggers for the same underlying regression across variants or when multiple eval suites detect the same drop. We need a canonicalization and handoff mechanism that ties eval regressions to change metadata (model version, quantization profile, autoscale config, routing policy) and deduplicates alerts in the Console notification fabric.
acceptance_criteria: Console receives a single consolidated incident for correlated eval regressions across multiple eval suites within a 30-minute correlation window
Alert payload includes change metadata: model_version, rollout_id, changed_config_keys, deployment_region, and presampled failing prompts
Slack threads are deduplicated using a sticky fingerprint so follow-ups append to the same thread rather than creating new ones for the same root cause
PagerDuty mapping uses severity heuristics and only fires a page when consolidated signal severity >= high or when automatic suppression expires
Operators can click through from the alert to an Evals Console panel pre-populated with the correlated eval runs, diff view, and lightweight repro runner
End-to-end tests validate dedupe behavior and that suppressed duplicate alerts are recorded in telemetry for audit
Rollout path supports opt-in for Dedicated/Private deployments with the same event schema and local delivery endpoints
tasks: Finalize event schema for EvalChangeSignal with fields for model_version, config_diff, rollout_id, sample_inputs, fingerprint_key
Design Console alert payload mapping and Slack thread key strategy in Console API docs
Implement signal consolidator service (stateless correlator + short-term redis cache) in evals backend
Add telemetry points: correlation_count, suppressed_alerts, avg_correlation_latency
Build Console UI anchor: 'Consolidated Eval Incident' panel with reproducibility kit link
Create PagerDuty runbook mappings and severity heuristics document
Create integration test harness that simulates concurrent eval regressions and config rollouts
decision_log: We will correlate signals by a configurable fingerprint combining model_version, rollout_id (if present), and a top-n set of failing test_ids to preserve precision
Correlation window default set to 30 minutes but exposed as a per-project setting in Console
Deduplication will favor sticky thread keys over muting to avoid losing conversation context
PagerDuty pages will be gated by consolidated severity; lower-severity incidents will create on-call visible incidents in Console but not page by default
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-aggressive dedupe hides distinct regressions. Mitigation: include fingerprints plus heuristic distance threshold and surface 'possible distinct regressions' in the UI
Risk: High latency introduced by correlator. Mitigation: design correlator as stateless with short TTL cache and async processing path with backpressure metrics
Risk: Private deployments need local delivery. Mitigation: provide webhooks and schema docs so customers can host a local correlator and integrate with their PD/Slack proxies
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only rollout for Platform and SRE to validate dedupe thresholds and PagerDuty gating (2 weeks)
Beta: opt-in for 3 high-traffic customers and internal product squads; gather feedback and tune heuristics (3 weeks)
GA: default enabled for hosted API; Console exposes per-project toggle and correlation window; provide deployment docs for Dedicated/Private (2 weeks)
Post-GA: expose ML-assisted grouping suggestions and allow custom fingerprint rules via Console
